svg.text: Maplog site set: draft marks for review
Priorities 1 and 2 of the site set, plus P3 marks only where a rule needs a demonstration. "kept" = already in Maplog v0.1.
P2. ticks on the lower side
Door + attribute (rule R3: small marks on the side they apply to)
Level changes (rule R4: down is the narrow end, chevron point, arrowhead or comb side)
Pits and traps (rule R7: letter beside the base, S secret, C covered, U ceiling)
